scope: Second review repair evidence. Correctness smokes and single-head observations, not a paired performance comparison.

actual_path_checks.session_internal_cancellation: Actual STAR provider raises CancelledError; AgentSession yields turn_cancelled, consuming task cancelling() remains zero, next turn completes
actual_path_checks.postcommit_observer_fault: Actual SQLite durable MODEL_CHANGED append survives observer ValueError; version matches committed sequence, projection invalidates, next STAR turn rebuilds and completes
actual_path_checks.session_caller_and_explicit_cancellation: Caller CancelledError propagates only after producer closes; explicit session.cancel yields normal turn_cancelled; two later turns complete; no stale recovery note
actual_path_checks.physical_worker_ownership: Actual non-cooperative blocking tool retained sole permit and effect ownership through repeated cancellation for 5.4 seconds until physical release; follower never overlapped, no premature terminal, final permits zero
actual_path_checks.explicit_temperature: Offline real LLMCaller -> LLM facade -> OpenAIProvider -> stub httpx transport: unset stream omits/sync0; explicit0 and0.0 sent both routes; explicitNone omits both;0.7 sent both. Runtime default omits stream, explicit0/0.6 preserved. No network.
actual_path_checks.compaction_ownership: Actual LLMCaller.call_llm_async enforced deadline: LLMTimeoutError, async summarizer sees cancellation, no late timeline write, no circuit failure. Sync-only summarizer remains joined through repeated cancellation; no physical worker outlives owner. Stale-generation replacement discards plan; concurrent append survives.
actual_path_checks.compaction_cancellation_precedence: Re-review caught worker exception replacing cancellation in both sync join paths. Repaired and smoke-proved: owner cancel then worker ValueError yields CancelledError after physical exit, no unretrieved exception, no circuit charge. Without cancellation worker ValueError still propagates.
actual_path_checks.sqlite_cancellation: Queued/executing BEGIN, body, COMMIT, repeated cancellation and all five write paths: cancelled caller, connection outside transaction, follow-up operations work. Outer lock now spans physical cleanup; deterministic queued competitor regression rejects prior lock-release gap. Worker direct smoke: 10/10 stage cases; baseline failed 8/10.
actual_path_checks.bash_inherited_pipes: Held descendant pipe leaves heartbeat/list responsive; busy-drain kill stays bounded without claiming EOF. Later gate release drains killed-outdescendant-out exactly once, signal exit code retained. Shell already reaped keeps its actual exit code 0; live process has no invented code.
actual_path_checks.file_lock_lifetime: Weak-value registry retains one lock while any holder/waiter owns a strong reference. Worker actual public edits over 200 distinct paths settle to 0 entries; same-path concurrency stays 1, distinct paths reach 4 concurrently. Real Read/Grep/Edit/Write execute blocking cores on workers; unmarked synchronous dispatch remains inline.
actual_path_checks.offload_lifecycle: Owned STAR/session pool close already existed; preserved. Added loop-safe awaited joins, atomic submit/closed check, and process-exit fallback close. Worker actual heartbeat: before 0 ticks during join, after 24; closing one session leaves sibling/default/future session usable.

mutable_alias_accounting_observation.limitation: Synthetic single-head local measurement. Dependency snapshots retain proportional payload memory and mutable comparisons remain linear; this workload does not show a speedup. No mutation semantics were disabled.

review_claim_corrections.benchmark_temp_directory: Existing finally block already calls shutil.rmtree. Actual benchmark confirms removal and no leaked threads; no leak fix needed.
review_claim_corrections.raw_measurements: Current tree contains a bounded summary with digest and immutable public raw URL pinned to a0da647. Raw artifact is linked, not uploaded as a separate release attachment.
review_claim_corrections.postgres_ci: Keep service-container contract job on every PR to catch shared-code and dependency regressions; accepts extra CI cost rather than path-filter gaps.

independent_reviews.session_cancel_and_observer: Read-only reviewer: no actionable findings; no tests or provider requests run.
independent_reviews.compaction_ownership: Read-only review found cancellation precedence defect in sync worker joins; fixed with actual cancel-then-worker-fails smokes and regression coverage.
independent_reviews.sqlite_ownership: Final source-only review: no actionable findings after outer-lock cleanup fix. Restoration/database-failure scenarios remain risks; unusable-connection failures are logged.
independent_reviews.bash_pipe_ownership: Final source-only review: no actionable findings after killed-task incomplete-drain fix. list_tasks retains a per-task 0.01-second drain budget, so many retained-pipe tasks can accumulate latency.

Full suite surfaced aiosqlite worker warning from two ACP failure-contract tests that closed the wire but not the owning agent. Allocation trace identified both; tests now close their agents.
Rejected pool submissions now settle the physical-work claim, preventing a no-work claim from draining forever.
